reason: A DeepSeek Harness skin that changes interface colors, typography, shapes, motion, and light/dark theme tokens according to Material You and Material 3 design conventions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Material You 和 Material 3 的蓝白配色、字体、圆角及浅深色外观主题。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness theme that applies Material You and Material 3 colors, typography, shapes, and light or dark appearance options.

capabilities: Applies Material 3 color tokens and typography to the DeepSeek Harness interface
Injects CSS and loads a bundled font for visual customization
Adds a theme bundle and patch entry to the DeepSeek Harness profile
